gates.name: Container end-to-end
gates.command: Invoke-Pester against ./tests-e2e (needs Docker; the tests build their own fixture image, nothing needs to be built first)

gates.name: Smoke test image
gates.command: run the workflow step's script verbatim against psgenerator:ci - BOTH assertions: PSVersion matches ^7.4., and Compare-Object of (Get-Command -Module SubZeroDev.PSGenerator).Name against Test-ModuleManifest ./src/SubZeroDev.PSGenerator.psd1 exported functions returns nothing

gates.name: Build Documentation (verify)
gates.command: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/workspace" -w /workspace --entrypoint pwsh ghcr.io/the-running-dev/docs-template:latest -NoLogo -NoProfile -File /template/scripts/docs-build.ps1 -SourceDocs ./docs -OutputPath artifacts/docs (needs Docker. NOT ./docs.ps1 -BuildOnly: that only assembles the image and never runs the site build, so it exits 0 on a repository whose docs cannot build)
